title: unitsGuidance
responsibility: Registers state-guidance and contract-review CLI commands, prints human or JSON reports, and preserves failing exit codes for unresolved gaps.

inputs.name: registerUnitsGuidance.units
inputs.description: Commander parent units command receiving the guide and check-contract subcommands.

outputs.name: registerUnitsGuidance
outputs.description: Returns no value. Registers commands whose actions print reports and set exit code 1 for missing states or contract findings.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, source-reader and evidence-validation failures from the invoked operation.
